name: Meta Suite Page Management
description: Master Autonomous Meta Suite Production Engine (v2.7.1): Facebook Page management that really posts AS your Page (auto Page discovery + profile switch, default Page), 1-click publishing & scheduling of Page Reels, Videos, Photos, Stories with custom thumbnails/covers, scheduled-queue manager, viral SEO + Meta algorithm audit, live trend radar (Google/YouTube, Reddit, X), anti-ad organic shield, and built-in DeepX Google Flow media engine (login check → Agent/Standard question → autopilot, automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks).
author: Dipesh Kr Yadav

mcp_tools.name: fb_status
mcp_tools.description:
Check Meta Suite and Facebook Automation status, verify bridge connectivity, and active login session.
    MANDATORY LITERAL FIRST TOOL CALL on any Meta Suite or Facebook task (<100ms).
    Returns ready status, logged_in state, active accounts, discovered pages, and queued jobs.

mcp_tools.name: fb_login_status
mcp_tools.description:
Open Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/) in the browser if not already open,
    detect current active login session, and persist one-time login state.
    IMPORTANT: If logged_in is false, tell the user once to sign in inside the open browser tab and STOP immediately.

mcp_tools.name: fb_open_browser
mcp_tools.description:
Explicitly open and focus Facebook in the browser (feed, reels, stories, page, or business_suite)
    and check one-time login readiness.

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish
mcp_tools.description:
ONE-TOUCH META BUSINESS SUITE PAGE PUBLISHER (Page Posts, Photos, Carousels, Videos, Reels, Stories):
    Dedicated strictly to Facebook Page Management via Meta Business Suite (business.facebook.com).
    MANDATORY RULES:
    1. ZERO OVERTHINKING: Call `fb_publish`, `fb_publish_reel`, or `fb_publish_story` directly as your FIRST tool call.
    2. UNIFIED PHOTO + DEEP QUOTE: Pass `media_paths=["latest"]` (or user file path), `title`, formatted multiline `caption` (Title -> blank line -> Quote -> Bullets -> CTA), and 3-6 `hashtags`.
    3. FORMATTED CAPTION & HASHTAGS: Keep `

` spacing between Title, Description, CTA, and `#Hashtags`.
    4. CUSTOM VIDEO THUMBNAIL: When uploading Page Videos with `thumbnail_path`, passes `thumbnail_path` to Edit Video -> Thumbnail panel.
    5. ORGANIC SHIELD: Strictly ensures 'Make this an ad post' is OFF.

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish_reel
mcp_tools.description:
DEDICATED META BUSINESS SUITE PAGE REELS PUBLISHER:
    Uploads a vertical 9:16 video as a Facebook Page Reel in Meta Business Suite:
    - Custom Cover / Thumbnail (`thumbnail_path`): automatically uploaded in Reel Cover panel.
    - Viral `title` + formatted multiline `caption` (`

` spacing preserved) + 3-6 `#Hashtags`.
    - Supports `video_path="latest"` to pick the newest vertical video automatically.

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish_story
mcp_tools.description:
DEDICATED META BUSINESS SUITE PAGE STORIES PUBLISHER:
    Publishes a Photo/Video Page Story (with optional short overlay `story_text`) or a Text Story.

mcp_tools.name: fb_resume_pending
mcp_tools.description: Resume and execute any pending Facebook task that was saved while waiting for the user's one-time login.

mcp_tools.name: fb_schedule
mcp_tools.description: Schedule ONE Facebook Page post, reel or story. With Meta connected (fb_meta_connect) it is created in Meta's own scheduler (Business Suite > Planner) and Meta publishes it; otherwise it publishes from this device (AntiGem must be open). Pass schedule_time_iso (e.g. 2026-11-22T09:00:00+05:30); with no time it takes the next safe slot. The Page Safety Governor moves any time that breaks a rule (daily post limit, minimum gap, night hours, duplicate text) and says so in adjusted_for_safety. For more than 3 posts use fb_schedule_bulk.

preferred_times.description: Optional local HH:MM times to prefer, e.g. ['09:00','19:30']

delivery.description: auto (default): Meta's own scheduler when connected, else this device.

mcp_tools.name: fb_schedule_bulk
mcp_tools.description: Schedule many Facebook Page posts at once (1-500 per call) in ONE call. With Meta connected (fb_meta_connect), posts are created in Meta's OWN scheduler (the one behind Business Suite > Planner): Meta publishes them even when this device is off. publish_first_now=true publishes post #1 immediately and schedules the rest. The Page Safety Governor picks the times: Pages up to 30/day with a 4-week warm-up above 6/day, evenly spaced (~30 min at 30/day, never back-to-back), personal profiles max 3/day; repeated captions/images and missing files are rejected. Reels, stories, profiles and groups post from this device at their time.

caption.description: Full post text. Every post must be different: duplicates are rejected.

schedule_time_iso.description: Optional exact time; moved to the next safe slot if it breaks a safety rule.

posts_per_day.description: Page feed posts + reels per day, 1-30 (default 3). Raising it here also updates the safety settings and restarts the warm-up from today's level.

preferred_times.description: Local HH:MM times, e.g. ['09:00','13:00','19:30']. Default: spread over posting hours.

publish_first_now.description: Publish the first post right away (respects today's limit and the 10-minute rule), schedule the rest.

delivery.description: auto (default): Meta's scheduler when connected and supported, else this device.

mcp_tools.name: fb_safety_settings
mcp_tools.description: View or change the Page Safety Governor limits used by fb_schedule, fb_schedule_bulk and the queue. action='get' | 'set' | 'reset'. Values are clamped at hard limits (Pages 30 posts/day with a 4-week warm-up above 6, 4 reels/day, 10 stories/day, 25 min gap; personal profiles 3/day).

mcp_tools.name: fb_meta_connect
mcp_tools.description: One-time connection to Meta's official scheduler (Graph API, the system behind Business Suite > Planner) so scheduled Page posts are published by Meta itself, with no browser automation. Best: credentials_file = path of a local JSON file {user_access_token, app_id, app_secret} (secret used once and never stored; the file is wiped after connecting; only Page tokens are kept). Or pass user_access_token (+ app_id/app_secret for a non-expiring token) or page_access_token. Returns setup steps if nothing is given. Never echo tokens.

default_page.description: Page id or name to use when a post has no target_id.

wipe_credentials_file.description: Empty the credentials file after a successful connection (default true).

mcp_tools.name: fb_meta_status
mcp_tools.description: Show the Meta scheduler connection: connected Pages, default Page, token problems, how many posts are already on Meta and how many are waiting for Meta's 28-day window.

mcp_tools.name: fb_meta_disconnect
mcp_tools.description: Remove the Meta scheduler connection. By default pulls future posts back from Meta first (they stay in the local queue and post from this device).

mcp_tools.name: fb_manage_queue
mcp_tools.description: Inspect and control the scheduled post queue: action='list'|'status' (counts, next/last post, pause state), 'cancel' (job_id), 'cancel_all', 'reschedule' (job_id + new_schedule_time_iso, moved to a safe slot if needed), 'run_now' (job_id, still respects the minimum gap), 'pause', 'resume' (only after the user checked the Page; after a Meta warning it halves the daily volume and restarts the warm-up). Cancel/reschedule also remove the post from Meta's scheduler when it was already handed over; pause pulls future posts back from Meta.

mcp_tools.name: fb_edit_post
mcp_tools.description: Re-edit an existing Facebook post's caption via DOM automation.

mcp_tools.name: fb_delete_post
mcp_tools.description: Delete an existing Facebook post or move it to trash.

mcp_tools.name: fb_list_posts
mcp_tools.description: List recent published, scheduled, awaiting_login, or failed Facebook posts from local database.

mcp_tools.name: fb_seo_generate
mcp_tools.description:
Generate an algorithm-optimized viral Facebook post with:
    - Mandatory Viral Title (`title`)
    - 1-line retention hook & deep quote
    - 3-4 punchy micro-bullets
    - Engagement CTA
    - 3-6 targeted `#Hashtags` (`hashtags`)
    - AI Image Model Thumbnail Prompt (`ai_thumbnail_prompt`)
    - First-comment link recommendation (protects organic reach)

mcp_tools.name: fb_thumbnail_prompt
mcp_tools.description: Craft an ultra-detailed, creative Master Art Direction prompt for generating a high-CTR clickbait thumbnail using an AI Image Model (Nano Banana Pro / Google Flow / image-generator subagent). STRICT MANDATE: NEVER use Python (PIL/Pillow/OpenCV) to generate thumbnails! Always pass this tool's prompt to the AI Image Model to render the thumbnail. Then generate the image with deepx_generate in THIS plugin (Google login check → ask Agent Mode or Standard → download:true) and pass files[0].path as thumbnail_path.

mcp_tools.name: fb_audit_caption
mcp_tools.description: Audit a post caption for Title, Hashtags, and Facebook algorithmic penalties (outbound links, hashtag stuffing, dense text).

mcp_tools.name: meta_viral_seo_generate
mcp_tools.description:
Generate an elite 2M-20M view scale viral SEO package for Meta Business Suite, Facebook Reels, and Instagram Reels:
    - High-CTR Pattern Interrupt Viral Title
    - 3-Second Retention Hook (Line 1 before 'See More' cutoff)
    - Anti-Book 1-2 line Micro-Takeaways with double whitespace
    - Comment Warfare Debate Driver (triggers multi-turn reply threads)
    - Share & Save Catalysts (12x Share and 6x Save algorithmic multipliers)
    - 3-6 Diamond Cluster Hashtags
    - Master AI Image Model Thumbnail Prompt (strictly compliant with Rule 8: AI Image Model ONLY, volumetric rim lighting, 3D gradient text)
    - Multimodal Semantic Keywords for Meta V-JEPA indexer.

mcp_tools.name: meta_viral_algorithm_audit
mcp_tools.description:
Rigorously audit any video or post caption against Meta's recommendation algorithm.
    Checks 3-second retention, outbound link penalties, comment warfare prompts,
    whitespace structure, and hashtag stuffing. Returns 0-100 score and viral reach tier.

mcp_tools.name: fb_trend_search
mcp_tools.description:
Real-Time Multi-Platform (live fetch inside the plugin, no Python needed) Viral Topic & Trend Search Engine:
    Scans YouTube / Google Trends, Twitter/X breaking topics, and Reddit in real time.
    Returns:
    - Ranked viral trends with Virality Momentum Scores (0-100)
    - 5-Stage High-Retention Script Blueprint (Golden Hook -> Disrupt Assumptions -> Unveil Insider Secrets -> Ultimate Truth -> Elevation & Discussion)
    - Google Flow character and asset visual generation prompt

mcp_tools.description: Check the built-in DeepX Google Flow engine: Google Flow login state in the AntiGem browser (LOGIN_REQUIRED with one message if not signed in) and available modes.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_meta_generate_design
mcp_tools.description: Generate high-converting social designs and photo cards on Google Flow  (🍌 Nano Banana 2.1). Built-in DeepX Google Flow engine: checks the Google Flow login first (LOGIN_REQUIRED → tell the user to sign in, stop), asks Agent Mode vs Standard once (ASK_GENERATION_MODE), downloads the result; poll deepx_job_status and use files[0].path. Standard mode auto-switches to Agent Mode on Google 'unusual activity' blocks. Never tell the user to generate in Google Flow manually.

aspect_ratio.description: 4:5 / 3:4 portrait feed (4:5 maps to 3:4), 1:1 square, 9:16 story, 16:9 landscape.

generation_mode.description: User's answer to 'Agent Mode or Standard mode (without Agent)?'. Omit until answered: the tool then returns ASK_GENERATION_MODE (after the Google login check).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning (default 20); then poll deepx_job_status.

mcp_tools.description: Generate an agency-grade high-CTR viral thumbnail for Facebook/Instagram  Google Flow. Standard mode auto-switches to Agent Mode on Google 'unusual activity' blocks. Never tell the user to generate in Google Flow manually.

generation_mode.description: User's answer to 'Agent Mode or Standard mode (without Agent)?'. Omit until answered: the tool then returns ASK_GENERATION_MODE (after the Google login check).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning (default 20); then poll deepx_job_status.

title_hook.description: Big headline text for the thumbnail.

Standard mode auto-switches to Agent Mode on Google 'unusual activity' blocks. Never tell the user to generate in Google Flow manually.

generation_mode.description: User's answer to 'Agent Mode or Standard mode (without Agent)?'. Omit until answered: the tool then returns ASK_GENERATION_MODE (after the Google login check).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning (default 20); then poll deepx_job_status.

mcp_tools.name: fb_comments
mcp_tools.description: Post a first comment (such as a resource link) or reply on a Facebook post.

mcp_tools.name: fb_doctor
mcp_tools.description: Diagnose local setup, database, WebSocket bridge, login status, and rate limits.

mcp_tools.name: meta_list_pages
mcp_tools.description: List the Facebook Pages this account manages (auto-discovered from facebook.com/pages, cached 6 h) plus the default Page used for target_id='me' and the Page currently acted as.

mcp_tools.name: meta_set_default_page
mcp_tools.description: Set the default managed Page used when target_id is 'me' (by Page URL, numeric ID, username or name).

page.description: Page URL, ID, username or name.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_generate
mcp_tools.description: AI images/videos for Facebook (thumbnails, Reel covers, post designs, short clips) through the built-in DeepX Google Flow engine. Checks the Google Flow login first (LOGIN_REQUIRED → tell the user to sign in, stop). If generation_mode is missing it returns ASK_GENERATION_MODE: ask 'Agent Mode or Standard mode (without Agent)?' and call again. Pass download:true and use files[0].path from deepx_job_status as thumbnail_path/media_paths. Standard mode auto-switches to Agent Mode on Google 'unusual activity' blocks; Agent Mode sends ≤24 prompts per part back-to-back. Never ask the user to generate in Google Flow manually.

generation_mode.description: REQUIRED answer from the user: 'agent' (Google Flow Agent Mode) or 'standard' (without Agent). Never guess: if the user has not chosen for this request, omit it and the tool returns ASK_GENERATION_MODE so you can ask.

media_type.description: 'image' or 'video'. Pass it explicitly when known.

prompt.description: One prompt, or a bulk request like '100 images of vintage cars' / '1 to 500 number designs' (auto-expanded).

prompts.description: List of prompts, one output item each (any length; Agent Mode splits into parts of ≤24, Standard mode accepts ≤500).

script_text.description: Storyboard/script; scenes separated by blank lines (or numbered lines). Use auto_breakdown for raw stories.

auto_breakdown.description: Analyze a raw story into scenes with @handles before generating.

model.description: Model shortcut for the media type (e.g. 'Nano Banana 2.1', 'Nano Banana Pro', 'Omni Flash 1.2', 'Veo 3.1 - Quality').

image_model.description: Image model (Agent: Nano Banana 2.1/Pro/2 Lite/Imagen 3; Standard: Nano Banana 2.1/Pro/2 Lite).

video_model.description: Video model (Agent: Omni Flash 1.2/Omni 1.1 Flash/Veo 3.1 Quality/Fast/Lite; Standard: Omni 1.1 Flash/Veo 3.1 Lite/Fast/Quality).

references.description: Standard mode: reference media IDs, @handles or local image paths.

max_per_part.description: Agent Mode items per pasted part (max 24, default 24).

total_count.description: Explicit total for a single subject prompt (e.g. 100).

custom_instructions.description: Agent Mode: persistent custom instructions to sync before pasting (defaults to DeepX Master Autopilot Director).

style_lock.description: Shared style sentence appended to every Agent part for consistency.

auto_fallback.description: Standard mode: switch to Agent Mode automatically when Google shows an unusual-activity / extension / captcha block (default true).

autopilot.description: Agent Mode: auto-approve credit cards and answer Flow Agent questions (default true).

download.description: Agent Mode: download new media to ~/flow-media when finished.

new_project.description: Standard mode: create a new project first.

part_timeout_sec.description: Agent Mode: max seconds to wait for one part before sending the next (default 480 image / 900 video).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning (0–45). Poll deepx_job_status afterwards.

dry_run.description: Standard mode: prepare and guard-block the request without spending credits.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_job_status
mcp_tools.description: Poll any DeepX job (Agent Mode queue, standard batch, auto-fallback) by job_id. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 30, max 50) for completion. Shows parts done, stage, media_ids and fallback_job when standard mode was switched to Agent Mode.

job_id.description: Job id from deepx_generate or another tool.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_check_login
mcp_tools.description: Check that a Google account is signed in to Google Flow in the AntiGem browser (opens Flow if needed). If not signed in it returns LOGIN_REQUIRED with one message to tell the user; otherwise continue with the task.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_status
mcp_tools.description: One-call readiness check: Google Flow tab, sign-in, project, Agent pill state, running jobs and whether standard mode was recently blocked. Opens Flow in the AntiGem browser if needed. Call at most once per session; never before deepx_generate.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_cancel_job
mcp_tools.description: Cancel a DeepX job (Agent Mode queue or standard batch) and its children. Omit job_id to cancel everything running.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_get_options
mcp_tools.description: DeepX knowledge: all Flow models, modes, ratios, durations, @handle referencing, prompt cinematography and the Agent vs Standard mode table.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_status
mcp_tools.description: Google Flow Agent Mode pill status on the current canvas (found / active / busy).

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_toggle
mcp_tools.description: Turn Google Flow Agent Mode on or off (omit active to toggle).

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_configure
mcp_tools.description: Configure Flow Agent settings: 100% autopilot ('Confirm before generating: Never'), default video/image model, aspect ratio, quality.

autopilot.description: Set Confirm before generating: Never (default true).

media_type.description: 'image' or 'video'. Pass it explicitly when known.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_set_instructions
mcp_tools.description: Write persistent custom instructions into Flow Agent (article_spark panel) for style/character consistency.

instructions_text.description: Instructions text (default: DeepX Master Autopilot Director).

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_approve_all
mcp_tools.description: Approve any pending Flow Agent credit card ('Always approve in project' / 'Approve') and answer a pending Agent question.

keywords.description: Topic words to pick the matching choice.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_batch_queue
mcp_tools.description: Agent Mode bulk queue for 1–5000 items (ranges like 1 to 1000, '100 images of X', or long prompt lists): ≤24 items per part, back-to-back, autopilot approvals. Returns a job.

prompt_or_storyboard.description: Bulk request ('100 images of cyber cars', '1 to 1000 numbers') or multi-item storyboard text (blank-line separated).

prompts.description: Explicit prompt list (split into parts of ≤24).

media_type.description: 'image' or 'video'. Pass it explicitly when known.

custom_instructions.description: Instructions to sync into Flow Agent first.

character_names.description: Character @handles to keep in every item.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_upscale_media
mcp_tools.description: Upscale a Flow image (2K/4K) or video (1080p/4K). Omit media_id to upscale the latest media.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_download_media
mcp_tools.description: Chrome Flow MCP compatibility alias for flow_download_media. Download media by ID or URL into local terminal storage, with an optional filename and folder.

url.description: Direct FifeURL or download redirect URL of the media.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_upload_asset
mcp_tools.description: Chrome Flow MCP compatibility alias for flow_upload_media. Upload local image/video files into a Flow project (through Flow's own upload, so they appear in the project). Returns their new media ids, usable as references or frames. Not needed before flow_generate_*: those accept local paths directly.

file_path.description: Absolute local path to the image or video file.

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_last_media
mcp_tools.description: Get the newest images or videos ("the last image", "the previous 2 videos"): first the results of this session's tools, then the newest items of the project. Use the returned media_id with other flow_* tools.

project_id.description: Project to look in (default: the open project)

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_media
mcp_tools.description: Get a Flow image or video as a local file (saved once in ~/flow-media; later calls reuse the same file, never copy it). Set view=true to also receive an image inline so you can look at it. To show it in chat, write ![caption](<path>) on its own line.

view.description: Also return the image inline for viewing (images only, default false)

mcp_tools.name: flow_list_media
mcp_tools.description: List images and videos in a Flow project (mediaId, type, title, prompt, size, pending). Optional query filters by title/prompt (like Flow's search box); pending_only lists videos still generating. cached_path is set when the file is already saved locally; use flow_get_media to fetch one.

project_id.description: Project ID (default: the project open in the Flow tab)

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text to search in titles and prompts

include_trashed.description: Also list media in Flow's trash (default false)
